name: Fixed income: USDC lending + stablecoin LP, Base
thesis: Hold USDC yield through two uncorrelated legs so the blended rate survives one of them compressing. Both legs are single-chain and stablecoin-only, which keeps the execution path free of bridging and of price exposure to the volatile asset — the point of a fixed-income mandate is that the return does not depend on the direction of a risky asset.

legs.intent: Supply 65,000 USDC to Aave v3 on Base
Provide 35,000 USDC to the deepest USDC/USDT pool on Uniswap v4, Base

notes: Floors are set from the pools that actually exist, not from a target. The deepest USDC/USDT uniswap-v4 pool on Base carried ~$135k TVL when this was written, so the LP leg floors at $100k and the notional is $10k: at 35% the LP position is ~$3.5k, a small fraction of that pool. A larger mandate needs a deeper venue — the constraint is pool depth, not the mandate. The lending leg clears its floor by two orders of magnitude (Aave v3 USDC on Base, ~$24.7M).
